name: SupportYourApp
summary: Outsourced customer support with human agents, AI agents for text and voice, or both, across chat, email, voice and social for SaaS, fintech and eCommerce teams.
best_for: startups and scale-ups in SaaS, fintech and eCommerce that want an outsourced, human-led support team, with or without AI, and can commit to a contract of at least 3 months
skip_if: you want a public price list, a self-serve tool you can start today, or a short or small contract with no minimum seat count
honest_knock: No prices are published, only a starting point given in a partner message and described as under review. The setup fee is not disclosed. Round-the-clock coverage needs at least 5 seats, and contracts start at 3 or 12 months. The figures on the vendor's site (96% CSAT with AI solutions, AI clearing up to 80% of routine tickets, 60% agent assist) are the vendor's own numbers, not our measurement.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pay-Per-Seat (starting point) · Pay-Per-Seat from $1,200 a month, given by SupportYourApp in a partner message on 23 Oct 2026
pricing.notes: (vendor answer, 23 October 2026; pricing page re-read 6 November 2026 shows no amounts) SupportYourApp does not publish prices: its pricing page says to get custom pricing. In a message to us on 23 October 2026 the company said its Pay-Per-Seat model starts from $1,200 a month and that this model is being reviewed, so treat the figure as a starting point, not a quote. It did not say whether the figure is per seat or for a team. Round-the-clock coverage needs at least 5 seats. Language mix and ticket volume change the price. Contracts run 3 months first and can then be cancelled, or 12 months; you can scale up or down within 30 days. New clients pay a one-time setup fee that is quoted per project. The pricing page also names a Pay-As-You-Go billing model. AI text agents are priced per resolution and AI voice agents per minute and per resolution. SupportCRM, the vendor's inbox, is free alongside another service, or $45 per seat with 1,000 AI responses on its own.
